create.name: Linda Hall
create.bio:
Linda Hall is a London meditation teacher, coach and healer who has taught meditation and body awareness since 2001. She began as an artist and craftsperson before moving into integrative health work, where she trained in holistic bodywork, therapeutic healing, coaching, neuro-linguistic programming, hypnotherapy and EFT. She is an accredited member of the Association for Therapeutic Healers and works on the psychology team at The Optimum Health Clinic Foundation, a UK charity.

Her teaching is secular and open to people of any belief. She works with simple tools such as grounding, breath, body scanning, guided imagery, affirmations and loving kindness, and puts weight on carrying these into ordinary daily life rather than keeping them for the cushion. She sees people one to one by video call, runs small ongoing online meditation groups, and has produced a series of guided audio programmes, from an eight-step course for beginners to longer collections on self-worth and inner steadiness. Her voice-led practices, many of them recorded with no music for sound-sensitive listeners, reach a wide audience through her YouTube channel and Insight Timer.

courses.title: Meditation for Beginners
courses.description: An audio course of about three hours that teaches meditation in short, clear steps, from settling the body to softening the breath and the heart. Each step pairs a little theory with a practice to use during the day.

free_resources.title: Linda Hall on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: A large library of gentle guided relaxations, body scans and visualisations, many voice-only, plus several courses. The single tracks are free to hear.

flags: Tier borderline: ~101k total, only just over the luminary line.

Much of her site and channel is sold on conditions (anxiety, depression, chronic illness, pain, sleep problems) and she works with a clinic for ME/CFS and fibromyalgia; only a small part passes the health-claim rule. A human may decide she belongs in the 'sold on conditions' skip group.

Her one-to-one sessions (£150 intro / £120 GBP) and online groups are her main way of working but both pages open with condition claims, so they were left out; add them back with clean wording if a human is comfortable.
Availability local_online is based on her site describing a London practice and 'London and Online' sessions; the session page itself lists only Skype, phone and Zoom.
